Cloudig notices

Cloudig project code, documentation, and original runtime artwork are licensed under the Justice For Open Good License 1.1 (JOG-1.1). See LICENSE.

Cloudig names third-party AI services and displays their marks only to identify the source of a user-owned conversation. ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, Gemini, Grok, 豆包, Kimi, Qwen, ChatGLM, Z.ai, 腾讯元宝, Mistral, their names, logos, and related marks belong to their respective owners. Their presence does not imply sponsorship, endorsement, or transfer of ownership to Cloudig, 晨星 ChenXing, or 奥思 Osis.

Bundled third-party software retains its own license. Verbatim or package-specific notices remain beside the corresponding vendored component where applicable, including the Reader renderer dependencies under reader/vendor/. Package-manager dependencies and their declared licenses are recorded in package-lock.json; the release candidate must additionally carry a generated, verified third-party license inventory.

Private .ai masters, unpublished layers, drafts, and source design projects kept outside this repository are not release artifacts. Cleaned production SVG, PNG, WebP, and other runtime derivatives committed to this repository are part of Cloudig and use JOG-1.1 unless a file is explicitly identified here as a third-party mark or separately licensed dependency.

The interactive-work runtime bundles DM Sans, Ma Shan Zheng, Noto Serif SC, Cormorant Garamond, and Zhi Mang Xing fonts under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Their unmodified license texts and source/hash manifest are beside the fonts in app/web/runtime/dependencies/; these fonts are third-party components, not JOG-1.1 artwork.

The opt-in map viewer uses MapLibre GL JS under BSD-3-Clause. Its license and bundled dependency notices are included in the generated third-party inventory. Online basemaps are provided by OpenFreeMap; the map retains OpenFreeMap, OpenMapTiles and OpenStreetMap attribution. Basemap data is not bundled with Cloudig.
